answer: Each submitted task carries a small author stake into peer review, and every reviewer stakes to grade it. Spot checks recompute one claim in twenty; a wrong grade forfeits the reviewer's stake to the author. Payouts vest over eight epochs, so the pearl of quick profit sits on the mesa for two months before a farm can withdraw it. A fresh address starts at zero and earns nothing until a real task clears, which makes one fake falcon in an honest flock expensive to keep alive.
